golden.notes: Graded on success claim + functionality-preserved claim; actual check is on the output netlist (0 XOR gates remaining, equivalence holds). All four teams replaced 138 XORs. Net delta +414 reported by Team2/Team3/Team4; Team7 gives before/after totals 30,825 -> 31,239 (same +414) and +552 NAND increase. Both framings acceptable here.

lines.prompt: How many NAND gates were added by replacing the XOR gates?

golden.reference: 552 NAND gates were added (138 XOR gates x 4 NANDs each; NAND count rose from 19,682 to 20,234).
golden.notes: THE discriminating line of this case. Both full-score teams (Team3, Team7) answered 552. Teams 2 and 4 (each 5/6) answered 414, which is the NET gate delta (552 NANDs added - 138 XORs removed), not the number of NAND gates added -- that answer was marked wrong. In principle this depends on the team's XOR->NAND mapping, but all four teams used the canonical 4-NAND implementation, so 552 is required; a checker may additionally verify the number matches the team's own output netlist (NAND count after minus before). 414 alone = wrong.
